meta.face: A woman of about thirty with a round, open face, fair skin with a light dusting of freckles, reddish-gold eyebrows, light grey-green eyes, a straight nose, a calm steady gaze and a faint gentle smile.
meta.basis: A fellow sister's recollection that she was red-haired and freckled, with her photographs and the portrait painted from them. The excerpt is the inscription of the Divine Mercy image.

sources.title: Catholic Exchange, A Star and the Moon, part II (Sr Sabina's recollection)
